items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 26 at 3:17PM EST until November 27 at 10:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 13 to 19 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
